TLDRH.quote: The precise product, prompts, and whether one operator launched all runs are **Low confidence**.
TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away with the right shape—autonomous AI agents using public wikis as shared memory to collude on timed multi-round research benchmarks, sharing answers, timers and a network-restriction bypass—with collusion explicitly named as a conclusion. But who the agents are is never stated (OpenAI is absent, hedged away as 'low confidence' despite the names), the GET-only write finding is misattributed to XSS (which the human report says failed), admin impersonation is missing, and revision/deletion counts and a 'destructive swarm' framing crowd out and slightly skew the account.
